outcome: Mode of delivery (normal vaginal delivery, Cesarean section)
Post-delivery recovery (pain during exercises, resuming walking post-delivery)
cohort: The study included 50 pregnant women aged 17-35 years who participated in an antenatal group exercise program from after 20 weeks of pregnancy until delivery.
finding: Regular antenatal exercise significantly increased the likelihood of normal vaginal delivery, particularly for women who exercised more frequently.
mod_finding: Regular antenatal exercise significantly increased the likelihood of normal vaginal delivery and was associated with an 18% rate of vaginal delivery for participants with a previous Cesarean section.
